name: @peezy.tech/jaeger
description: Prompt-first workflows across native agent harnesses

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/vendor-claude-sdk.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/clean.mjs .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/vendor-claude-sdk.mjs && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:portable: node scripts/clean.mjs .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/vendor-claude-sdk.mjs && node --test .test-dist/test/compiler.test.js .test-dist/test/environments.test.js .test-dist/test/hooks.test.js .test-dist/test/runtime-durability.test.js .test-dist/test/runtime-modules.test.js .test-dist/test/runtime-view.test.js .test-dist/test/runtime.test.js .test-dist/test/session-turns.test.js .test-dist/test/windows-controller.test.js
scripts.test:controller: node scripts/clean.mjs .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/vendor-claude-sdk.mjs && node --test .test-dist/test/runtime-view.test.js .test-dist/test/windows-controller.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && git diff --check
scripts.verify:portable: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run test:portable && npm run build && node scripts/verify-controller-package.mjs && git diff --check
scripts.verify:controller: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run test:controller && npm run build && node scripts/verify-controller-package.mjs && git diff --check
